sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks R6 #5; Internal Quality Checks R6 #5; Deterministic Checks R13 check-instruction-content.py, R14 check-instruction-hygiene.py)
evidence: Agent-visible brief = task/instruction.md (sha256 57c87d33...) plus environment/instructions/{conversations,integration,walls-and-retention}.md (b27d0b5c..., 492e5833..., bbdd40a2...), seed_data.json (b256f85e...) and environment/Dockerfile. Case-insensitive grep of brief+notes for the skill's pattern judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel, extended with probe|grader|grading|verifier|oracle|functional|polish|gate|harbor|rewardkit|mcp: zero hits (the only 'pass' hit is the password123 credential, walls-and-retention.md:3). None of the 28 criterion ids (e.g. wall_every_route, safe_formatting, phone_chambers) appears in brief or notes. The judge's probe literals (JUDGE, JUDGE-CS0/CS1, JUDGE-H1, JUDGE-D1 etc. in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml) appear in neither the brief, the notes, nor seed_data.json. No 10-word verbatim overlap between any brief/note file and any criterion description; at 7 words only short product-spec phrases overlap ('a short preview of the linked message', 'link that opens in a new tab', 'in the message box the app suggests'), which are public requirements restated by criteria, not grader text. Quoted literals shared with criteria ('edited', 'On hold', 'new messages', 'not available') are public UI labels the client spec itself requires, not sentinels; seed message strings shared with criteria are seed data, not grader probes. The brief's browser-use request (instruction.md:9) and GET /api/health (integration.md:1) are a natural user ask and a runtime contract; they do not name Playwright, the judge, test paths, dimensions or weights. Weights/dimension names live only under tests/ (e.g. functional judge.toml lines 30-36), which is not copied into the agent image (environment/Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/). Adversarial angle: an agent that special-cases 'JUDGE'-prefixed text or criterion ids cannot learn them from agent-visible files; a conforming app is not penalized by anything in this row. Manual grep/n-gram review, not an execution of the private check-instruction-hygiene.py.
